say:2:1830415002:1.text: I saw him perform the ritual and decided to have a little fun. I asked some birds in the woods to tap on his window.
say:2:1830415002:1.source_cn: 是我看到他做了那个仪式，想吓吓他，所以就拜托树林里的鸟...

say:3:1830415003:1.text: He was so sure the curse was nonsense before. Look at him now—he's terrified! What could be funnier?
say:3:1830415003:1.source_cn: 你看他那副胆小的样子，跟之前不信邪是不是截然不同？多有趣！
